## Problem

Describe the concrete problem.

## Change

Explain previous and new behavior.

## Validation

List tests, platform, compiler and configuration.

## Compatibility

State whether this affects sound, parameters, saved states, CPU, latency,
VST3 or Standalone.

## Checklist

- [ ] I built every affected target.
- [ ] I ran the relevant tests.
- [ ] Existing parameter identifiers remain compatible or include a migration.
- [ ] No unlicensed third-party files were added.
- [ ] Documentation was updated.
